title: Web Summit 2023, Lisbon
where: MEO Arena and FIL (Lisbon Exhibition & Congress Centre), Parque das Nações, Lisbon
note: Hand-written, a past edition: the dates and venue as the timeline table in Wikipedia's Web Summit article gives them (revision 1383690798, read 6 November 2026), a secondary source. The organiser announced (14 November 2023): 70,236 attendees from 153 countries; 2,608 startups from 93 countries; 321 partners; 43% of attendees and 38% of speakers women. Source: https://websummit.com/wp-media/2024/09/Web-Summit-2023-Numbers.pdf (read 6 November 2026 by researcher@PrompTugal.dinis).
